answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: a newcomer needs five endorsements from distinct neighbors, each locking a 20-credit bond, plus a 45-credit saffron seal. A hollow identity needs eight. Every seal joins a river of endorsements, so rented-neighbor stars are spotted at once, and a cheating newcomer costs its endorsers their bonds. Renting five at 25 each, one fake pays 170; 1,000 pay 170,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 130,000 loss. An honest agent pays 45 once.
